scope: Descriptive evidence availability in 44 mapped settings from 15 sources; not a quality score, field prevalence or independent coding study.

rules.access: Classify the input rights of the evaluated setting: transit metadata, addressed recipient data, active intervention/probing, or a downstream derived preference analysis. Source groups can overlap.
rules.purpose: Restrict adaptation/utility counts to intervention comparisons protecting research-query or workflow information. Separate identity obfuscation and blocking adversarial agents.
rules.adaptation: Located protected-condition fitting or adaptive comparison for the stated setting; this does not certify optimal attack strength or every possible adaptation.
rules.utility: Located original-task quality or goal outcome for the same intervention. Bytes, latency, attacker cost, and extra-query counts alone do not satisfy it.
rules.not_located: The retained setting record does not establish the requested item. This is not evidence that it is absent from all artifacts or never measured.
